children: AIM ImmunoTech completed two debt-for-equity exchanges with Streeterville Capital on September 8 and 9, 2026, converting approximately $400,000 of principal from a November 18, 2025 promissory note into 1,749,434 shares of common stock. The average conversion price was about $0.228 per share. The exchanges followed stockholder approval granted on July 15, 2026 under NYSE American rules. Management expects the transactions to reduce debt and enhance financial flexibility.
